title: OLEANDER Building Services / MEP Design Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic building-services engineering from strategic performance definition through in-use operation while preserving system-specific responsibility, commissioning continuity, operational-energy boundaries, cross-disciplinary interfaces, native engineering outputs and actual readback.
scope_in: electrical power and associated life-safety interfaces
fire/life-safety MEP systems within assigned responsibility
plant, distribution, access, replacement and maintainability
testing, commissioning, handover, fine tuning and in-use performance
scope_out: automatic electrical certification outside assigned authority
automatic measured-performance claim from design calculation
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Cross-Disciplinary Integration and the responsible building-services engineer / jurisdiction authority.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires building-services feasibility, performance, design, coordination, production, commissioning, handover or in-use judgment.
responsibility_triggers: MEP shared variable consumed by Architecture, Structure, Fire, Interior, Envelope or FM
specialist or contractor services design dependency
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest applicable current claim ceiling across mounted source evidence, system engineering evidence, interface maturity, commissioning evidence and external professional/statutory authority governs.
not_triggered_when: non-authoritative plant or services placeholders with explicit exclusion of engineering performance
mandatory_reopen_triggers: commissioning failure or material installation nonconformity
measured operation materially contradicts design assumptions

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential MEP standards, climatic/utility facts, manufacturer data, existing-system evidence, commissioning criteria and operational-energy methods must be admitted through task/claim-scoped operational mounts before they support a professional decision.
source_routes: BSRIA BG 6/2018 Design framework for building services
standard_code_routes: jurisdiction-specific MEP, energy, electrical, public-health and life-safety requirements
precedent_case_routes: bounded building-services precedents where applicability is established
practice_routes: current OLEANDER MEP practice / commissioning / failure evidence
tool_knowledge_routes: current calculation, simulation, CAD/BIM and controls-data execution guidance when used

stages.professional_question: What servicing, utility, resilience, environmental and operational-performance consequences materially affect the strategic project decision?
entry_conditions: strategic project need and high-level use exist
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential utility, climate, existing-system and strategic services sources before making feasibility claims.
required_native_outputs: initial performance and utility risk register

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: strategic project brief and services constraints record
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when project use, site, utility or strategic environmental strategy materially changes.

human_experience_consequences: strategic comfort, resilience and service continuity implications where in claim
technical_consequences: strategic servicing and performance feasibility constraints
content_projection_requirements: show utility/performance constraints, assumptions and evidence state
required_readback: read strategic decision against actual utility/climate/existing-system evidence state
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent or distinct peer review where consequence, novelty, system complexity or authority requires it.
open_items_allowed: later load, topology, equipment and commissioning design
exit_conditions: material strategic services constraints and unknowns are explicit

stages.stage_name: Services Brief / Basis of Building Services Design
stages.professional_question: Is there an authoritative enough demand, performance, responsibility and commissioning basis to begin system concept design?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential standards, climatic/utility evidence, client operational requirements and existing-system evidence at the current claim ceiling.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current architectural brief plus Basis of Building Services Design
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when use, occupancy, schedule, room condition or performance criteria materially changes.

human_experience_consequences: comfort, IAQ, water, lighting-power and service continuity requirements where applicable
content_projection_requirements: show assumptions, design conditions, system boundaries, responsibility and commissioning success criteria
required_readback: read basis against current project brief and mounted authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Distinct review of demand/performance assumptions and commissioning basis for material systems.
open_items_allowed: later system concept and technical design
exit_conditions: material demand, performance, responsibility and commissioning inputs are explicit

stages.professional_question: Which building-services system concepts are credible and why should the selected topology continue?
entry_conditions: current services brief and design basis
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential system, load, utility, standard and performance-method knowledge before retaining a concept.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: concept MEP schematics and coordinated architectural option geometry
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when massing, zoning, plant reserve, system topology or environmental strategy changes.

design_language_consequences: visible terminals, plant/enclosure, grille/louvre or service-expression consequences where material
technical_consequences: system boundary/topology and concept capacity basis
content_projection_requirements: compare system options with assumptions, performance consequences, space and commissioning implications
stages.independent_review_requirement: Concept-stage review appropriate to system complexity, risk and performance claim.
exit_conditions: credible system concept retained with bounded assumptions and interface consequences

stages.professional_question: Are plant, risers, routes, terminals, access, replacement paths and builder's-work interfaces coordinated enough for other disciplines to rely on them?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount changed consequential standards, product/system data and source conditions before spatial geometry is treated as current.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: coordinated MEP model/drawings plus current architectural model/drawings
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when coordinated room/ceiling/riser/plant/access geometry materially changes.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current coordinated structural and MEP model/drawings
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when openings, support loads, structural zones or service routes change.

human_experience_consequences: clear height, acoustic, access and terminal-placement consequences
content_projection_requirements: critical sections through risers/ceilings/plant/access and builder's-work interfaces
stages.independent_review_requirement: Spatial/interface review distinct from clash detection alone.
open_items_allowed: later detailed equipment/network/control design outside current spatial claim
exit_conditions: in-claim critical MEP space/access/interface geometry meets required Integration maturity

stages.stage_name: Technical System Design / Controls / Commissioning Specification
stages.professional_question: Are system duties, equipment, networks, protection, controls and commissioning requirements technically complete at the declared responsibility boundary?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current governing standards, project conditions, manufacturer/product evidence and commissioning criteria before technical closure.

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen on material equipment, route, access, terminal or architectural-interface change.

human_experience_consequences: verified design intent for comfort/IAQ/noise/water/power/controls where within modelled claim
design_language_consequences: final visible-service and terminal consequences where material
technical_consequences: complete technical system design within assigned responsibility
stages.professional_review_owner: Responsible Building Services / MEP professional owner
stages.independent_review_requirement: Required engineering/peer/discipline checking according to system risk, complexity, jurisdiction and appointment.
open_items_allowed: specialist installation/fabrication detail explicitly assigned outside current technical responsibility
exit_conditions: technical system design and required review close at declared responsibility boundary

stages.professional_question: Is technical services design translated into coordinated installation and specialist information without losing engineering intent or commissioning access?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount consequential specialist/product/installation evidence and changed design basis before production release.
required_native_outputs: Equipment / System Submittal & Substitution Release Register
Builder's Work / Installation / Access Coordination Register

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: coordinated MEP production information and structural production information
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when support/restraint/opening/base/load or installation route materially changes.

human_experience_consequences: maintainable access and retained usable clearances
content_projection_requirements: show specialist responsibility, access/testing provisions and unresolved interfaces
stages.professional_review_owner: Building Services / MEP professional owner with assigned specialist reviewers
stages.independent_review_requirement: Review specialist/installer information against engineering design intent and assigned checking requirements.
exit_conditions: assigned specialist/installation information integrated and reviewable

stages.professional_question: Does the installed system conform to current design intent and demonstrate required functional and integrated performance at the commissioned claim ceiling?
entry_conditions: current commissioning requirements and approved changes available
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current commissioning/test criteria and changed product/system evidence before accepting test results.
required_native_outputs: Inspection / Test / TAB / Commissioning Witness Matrix
MEP RFI / Field Change / Defect Register

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: current commissioning and integrated systems test records plus controlling fire authority evidence
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when fire strategy, life-safety control logic or tested configuration changes.

human_experience_consequences: demonstrated system function for occupied/operational conditions within test scope
technical_consequences: installation conformity and functional/integrated test evidence
content_projection_requirements: distinguish design intent, installed state, test result, limitation and unresolved defect
stages.professional_review_owner: Building Services / MEP professional owner and assigned commissioning authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Witnessing/independent verification according to specification, risk, statutory requirement and commissioning plan.
open_items_allowed: explicit later seasonal/fine-tuning items outside handover acceptance
exit_conditions: required installation/test/commissioning evidence closes at the declared system claim ceiling

stages.professional_question: Can the systems be safely and competently operated, maintained and monitored at handover with unresolved items explicit?
entry_conditions: required construction/commissioning scope sufficiently complete for handover decision
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current handover/commissioning criteria and final system configuration evidence before closure.
required_native_outputs: O&M / Asset / Training / Seasonal Closeout Register

interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when final system configuration, operator requirements or material handover evidence changes.

human_experience_consequences: operational readiness and safe user/operator interaction where in claim
content_projection_requirements: co-locate handover status, unresolved defects, seasonal tasks and responsible owner
stages.professional_review_owner: Building Services / MEP professional owner with client/FM/commissioning participation
stages.independent_review_requirement: Handover verification must be distinct from installer self-declaration where required by specification/risk/authority.
open_items_allowed: explicit seasonal testing/fine tuning with owner/date/claim boundary
exit_conditions: handover claim supported by commissioning, information, training and open-item evidence

stages.stage_name: In-use Review / Fine Tuning / Measured Performance
stages.professional_question: How do actual operation, trends, faults, energy and user outcomes compare with the design/commissioning basis, and what must be corrected or learned?
entry_conditions: sufficient measured/operational data for the intended review
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Mount current measurement/method/benchmark context before claiming measured performance or causal diagnosis.

interface_bindings.native_source_of_truth: measured operating data plus current FM/controls records
interface_bindings.change_reopen_rule: Reopen when operating mode, controls, occupancy, maintenance state or measured dataset materially changes.

technical_consequences: measured design-versus-operation comparison and corrective actions
content_projection_requirements: separate design prediction, commissioned baseline, measured result, uncertainty and causal inference
stages.professional_review_owner: Building Services / MEP professional owner with FM/controls/energy participation as applicable
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent measurement/analysis review when consequential performance claims or contractual/statutory outcomes depend on it.
open_items_allowed: future-season data or long-term optimization outside current measurement window
exit_conditions: bounded measured-performance claim and corrective/learning actions are evidence-backed

controlling_authority_requirements: current project brief and design basis
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Resolve actual enter/close maturity per interface binding and Acceptance Contract; do not compile a profession-wide scalar maturity truth.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: remaining work is explicitly later/outside claim
required current maturity is already met

required_native_outputs: measured performance records where in scope
Equipment / System Submittal & Substitution Release Register
Builder's Work / Installation / Access Coordination Register
Inspection / Test / TAB / Commissioning Witness Matrix
MEP RFI / Field Change / Defect Register
O&M / Asset / Training / Seasonal Closeout Register
native_source_of_truth_rules: equipment datasheets do not replace system calculations or installation evidence
design calculation does not replace measured performance
commissioning evidence must correspond to the tested configuration
tool_adapter_requirements: use Current Skill Resolver and live registry; no hardcoded global tool inventory
actual_readback_requirements: read actual engineering source and coordinated geometry
read actual control/commissioning evidence when claimed
read actual measured operation for in-use claims
equipment/system submittal and substitution critical-attribute release readback
inspection/test/TAB/commissioning witness matrix readback against the exact tested configuration
field RFI/change/defect propagation and O&M/asset/training/seasonal closeout readback

execution_depth_contract.parity_rule: Equivalent MEP execution depth is demonstrated through system duties/topologies, coordinated installation objects, submittal release, executed test/commissioning evidence and operable handover.
assumption_uncertainty_objects: Basis of Building Services Design assumptions
release_control_objects: Equipment / System Submittal & Substitution Release Register
Builder's Work / Installation / Access Coordination Register
implementation_field_objects: Inspection / Test / TAB / Commissioning Witness Matrix
MEP RFI / Field Change / Defect Register
handover_inuse_objects: O&M / Asset / Training / Seasonal Closeout Register
independent_review_objects: distinct reviewer/witness where risk, statutory, contractual or commissioning stage requires it
professional/commissioning review of exact tested configuration
change_propagation_objects: commissioning record staleness after configuration change
does_not_require: same stage count as other domains

assurance.professional_review: Building-services professional review at the current system/stage claim ceiling.
assurance.evidence_review: Check source authority, calculation/model assumptions, manufacturer evidence, installed/test configuration and measured-data provenance as applicable.
assurance.independent_review: Required where risk, novelty, statutory/contractual condition or process stage demands a distinct reviewer/witness; producer self-check alone does not satisfy independence.
assurance.receipt_contract: Professional receipt records stage/process verdict, claim ceiling, current configuration/baseline, open items, readback refs, commissioning/measured evidence where applicable and does-not-prove boundary.

stale_scope_rules: invalidate only affected calculations, networks, models, controls, interfaces, commissioning records and receipts unless dependency analysis shows wider consequence
upstream_impact_rules: changed brief, architecture, structure, fire, envelope, utility, product or standard input propagates to consuming MEP stages
downstream_impact_rules: changed MEP loads, plant, routes, openings, controls or test status propagates to consuming professions and commissioning/handover
interface_reopen_rules: reopen affected Integration interfaces when shared variables or acceptance criteria change
receipt_stale_rules: professional receipts become stale at affected scope when the tested/designed configuration or governing evidence changes

process_exit_conditions: all triggered MEP tracks close at their declared current claim ceiling
required actual readback and professional/commissioning evidence exist
open items are explicitly later/outside claim and non-contradictory
G9/in-use status is explicit when applicable
open_items_allowed: explicit later seasonal/fine-tuning or future measurement scope outside the current promoted claim
completion_contract.professional_receipt: MEP professional process receipt compiled from current stage instances and commissioning/in-use evidence.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Professional PASS may satisfy a bounded Master professional-process prerequisite only; it does not award Design KEEP, statutory approval or Promotion.
